title: Dr. Gloo
tagline: The simplest token aggregator experience yet. Gloo your tokens!
description: Dr. Gloo is a token aggregator that simplifies the process of aggregating different tokens from different wallets and chains into a single output token and chain. We want to make it as easy as possible to make crypto payments (or even cleanup of wallets), minimizing the hassle that usually represents having to manually swap tokens, and then send them to the destination chain/wallet.
how_its_made: We are using Circle CCTPv2 in order to bridge USDC between target and destination chains, while we use 1inch in order to make swaps. Additionally, we made it compatible with Ledger to even increase the benefits of using our solution. The idea is that with our simple and streamlined process, is it possible to handle a bulk amount of tokens in a painless way.
